assumptions.abilityGeneration: Primary class stat starts at 14 (+2 mod); Constitution at 12 (+1). Race abilityBonuses applied. Human: +1 all scores (Versatility baseline).
assumptions.armorClass: 10 + DEX mod + armor tier (heavy +6, medium +3, light +1, unarmored Monk +WIS if applicable, none +0). +1 from Natural Armor trait.
assumptions.attacks: Level-5 attack profiles by class role: martials 2× weapon, casters 1× spell/force, support 1× mixed. Damage = die average + ability mod.
assumptions.raceTraits: Percent bonuses parsed from racial-variants ability/feat text and races.js traits (damage %, regen, miss chance, resist DR). Missing Drakari variants use parent-race Drakari defaults.
assumptions.foeSelection: Non-boss only: exclude Gate Guardian tag and floor-encounters.json boss names. Requires AC+HP+structured combat from Excel ingest.
assumptions.soloCrBands: CR 1–4 for L5 solo (easy→hard); up to 3 sample foes per CR band.
assumptions.partyCrBands: CR 5 for L5 party-of-4 (rotating slot); up to 3 sample foes.
assumptions.partyTemplate: Fixed Warrior + Cleric + Mage L5; 4th slot = tested race/class combo.
assumptions.incomingDamage: Structured at-will + draft recharge cadence from monster-combat.mjs; CR proxy fallback if payload missing.
assumptions.scoring: survivalPct = max(0, 100 − expectedLoss/hp×100). deathFlag = expectedLoss ≥ hp. synergyScore = mean solo survivalPct.
